after.prompt: Consider the argument “p ∨ q; p; therefore ¬q”. Which assignment is a counterexample?
after.exampleAnswer: When p and q are both true, the premises p ∨ q and p hold, but the conclusion ¬q is false. Inclusive ‘or’ permits this counterexample.
